meta.name: WeduLab homepage with laboratory theme variants
meta.description: SOURCE CSS tokens from Home-CfI5xIBn.css; qualitative style descriptions are inferred. Laboratory exact values are retained in route CSS rather than flattened into one palette.

color.palette_type: cool neutral palette with subject-specific accent colors
color.contrast_strategy: dark text on light layered surfaces

font_families.heading: Chakra Petch with Chinese system sans fallbacks
font_families.body: Chakra Petch, PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Noto Sans SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
font_families.mono: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

typography.font_style_notes: Latin technical lettering; laboratory long-form content also uses Noto Serif SC.

spacing.base_unit: SOURCE background grid: 24px; spacing constants preserved in CSS
spacing.section_rhythm: card grid followed by spaced social section

layout.grid_system: responsive CSS grid; three desktop card columns

border_radius.pill: feedback trigger and language controls use original CSS

elevation.shadow_style: subtle drop shadow and hover accent
elevation.depth_cues: white cards, borders and SVG glow

iconography.stroke_weight: SOURCE varies by SVG drawing; retained catalog SVG strings
size_scale: card preview SVG viewBox sizes retained

motion.easing: original CSS easing and SVG SMIL timing retained
motion.exit_pattern: filter changes; original React state retained

components.button_style: small outlined chips and language menu
components.card_style: white cards with clipped 12px corners and subject accent
components.navigation_pattern: sticky 64px brand header; category filter; linked experiment cards
components.list_style: subject topic tags in each card
components.component_notes: Home initial 12 cards; expand reveals all 22. Laboratory pages have distinct original control panels.

visual_language.ornamentation: grid background, clipped corners and animated SVG

composition.hierarchy_method: brand, filters, preview, title, description, tags, action
composition.grouping_strategy: subject filters and equal card grouping
composition.negative_space_role: separates tool previews and social information

imagery.graphic_elements: circuits, contours, orbits, molecules and particles

interaction_feel.feedback_style: hover border/accent and pressed filter states

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: explicit error message and return-home link

overview.primary_technology: SVG/CSS homepage; original Three/WebGL and Canvas2D laboratory runtimes

background_effects.description: 24px light grid with blue radial wash

svg_animations.description: original catalog inline SVG animation strings retained

visual_effects.composite_notes: Enabled flags describe homepage only. Experiments retain their own WebGL/Canvas scene definitions. Exact viewport, renderer context, source binding and source-replay evidence for contour are documented under shader/. No effect was recreated by visual guessing.
